title: Dragon's Ice Boat Racing Plus
description: This texture pack enhances Vanilla blocks to make Minecraft's best sport feel simpler!
body:
Ice Boat Racing, Minecraft's best sport, can feel overwhelming sometimes, and not very special.

This pack aims to change that, by overhauling Vanilla Minecraft's blocks and GUI to give IBR its own flair, tweaking it _just__ enough where it feels Vanilla, yet better.

**DISCLAIMER**: This pack is still in development, but you can follow this project so you get updates about major changes.
